warehouse/31315.htm.text: Freighter Daisy: ??, ??, ?? -- my beloved siblings, all 3 of them, though they can be a handful! Ah well, I wouldn't trade them for their weight in gold. You know, it is very rare for the whole family to be posted to the same place, even within the same guild. We owe our good fortune to Uncle ???. …

warehouse/31315-noteach.htm.text: Freighter Daisy: Oh, my! I only teach Scavengers and Bounty Hunters, and sometimes the occasional Dwarven Fighter. But I'm afraid there's nothing I can teach you...

Q00018_MeetingWithTheGoldenRam/31315-01..text: Warehouse Freightman Daisy: Uncle Donal sent you? Here's the box! Heavy, isn't it? Deliver it quickly before the winter comes!

Q00018_MeetingWithTheGoldenRam/31315-03..text: Warehouse Freightman Daisy: Hurry and deliver the box to Mercenary Supplier Abercrombie! I marked the Map, didn't I?

Q00018_MeetingWithTheGoldenRam/31315-02..text: Warehouse Freightman Daisy: Take it to the mercenary forces temporary outpost in the east part of the Swamp of Screams. I'll mark it on your Map. Speak with Mercenary Supplier Abercrombie. Thanks, and be careful!

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
